|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &9Yoshua&f: Do you ever feel like we're just programmed to do certain things in life?
&e[NPC] &aSkylark&f: I used to, because it seems like everything you CAN do is pre-determined, like a computer program.
&e[NPC] &aSkylark&f: Like an all-powerful entity created this world and everything that can exist in it.
&e[NPC] &9Yoshua&f: What made you change your mind?
&e[NPC] &aSkylark&f: Well, think of it like a video game.
&e[NPC] &aSkylark&f: The main storyline may be fixed.
&e[NPC] &aSkylark&f: But that doesn't stop the player from creating their own stories and experiences within the game.
&e[NPC] &aSkylark&f: Especially when playing with others!
}}
|}
== Trivia ==
*'''Skylark''' is one of 5 [[NPC]]'s to mention the "simulation" or the simulated state of the world of skyblock. Others include the [[Royal Resident]], the [[Cult of the Fallen Star]] members in meetings #4 - #6, [[Oen]], and [[Yoshua]].
